service.description: The approval rule rows of the employers in the caller's scope (or the one asked for, refused outside it, ORGANIZATION_DENIED) and of a kind, in effect on asOfDate (now) or every row with includeEnded: each with its employer, kind, scope (employee, department or whole employer), step, role, approver and alternate names, dates, state (current, future, ended), revision and canEdit (PEOPLE_CONFIGURE). Paged. Read by the People administrator and an HR reader (PEOPLE_CONFIGURE or PEOPLE_HR_VIEW; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise).

A new approval rule row of an employer and kind from fromDate (now when empty): a step (sequenceNum, 1 when empty) decided by a role (ParDepartmentHead, ParManager, ParPerson with approverPartyId, ParHr with an optional designated officer), for the whole employer, a department of it or one employee (an override), with an optional alternate; or the employer's HR fallback for the kind (ParHrFallback with the person). With peopleApprovalPolicyId, a row's new terms (the row in effect ends on the change's date, fromDate or now, never before now, and the next starts; a row not yet in effect changes in place) or its end (thruDate alone, never before now), each audited with changeReason. The waiting requests of the employer and kind are routed again (a request that waited for an approver is sent to the one it has now). Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED), no employer (ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED) or one outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a kind not built (KIND_INVALID), a role that is not one (ROLE_INVALID), a named role with no person (APPROVER_REQUIRED), a step outside 1 to 20 (STEP_INVALID), a department that is not one (NOT_A_DEPARTMENT) or not the employer's (DEPARTMENT_OUTSIDE), an employee the employer does not employ or an approver or alternate who does not work for it (NOT_EMPLOYED), an employee's rule naming them to decide (SELF_APPROVAL), a step another row of the same scope holds then (STEP_EXISTS), dates out of order (DATES_INVALID), a row outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or ended (RULE_ENDED) and a revision other than the one read (REVISION_CHANGED).

The route of an example request, explained (design §12 ResolvePreview): for an employer and kind, the department (or a position, which gives both), the person it is about (subjectPartyId) and the requester, the basis of its rules (employee, department, type or the default manager route) and each step with its role, who decides it now and how (the role, the alternate, the HR fallback, or no one: the request would wait), never the requester or the person it is about. Read by the People administrator and an HR reader (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise); refuses an employer outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), a position outside it (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a department not the employer's (NOT_A_DEPARTMENT, DEPARTMENT_OUTSIDE) and a person the employer does not employ (NOT_EMPLOYED).

parameter.name: steps
parameter.description: sequenceNum, stepText, approverRoleEnumId, roleText, approverPartyIds, approverNames, via (route, alternate, fallback, or null), unresolved, explanation

service.description: The shared decision of a People approval the domain decision services call (decide#PositionApproval): the step waiting of the request (peopleApprovalId, else the latest of the kind's source) approved, or refused with a reason, as a PeopleApprovalDecision (actor, step, rule row, role, revision, time, reason). Rechecks the decider's authority (an approver of the step waiting by the employer's rules now, never the requester or the person it is about, nor one who decided another step, nor one who no longer works for the employer) and the source's revision, with the request locked and read again. The last step's approval approves the request, a refusal refuses it, and either reads the notices; an approval of an earlier step sends the next step's. A decision the caller already made of the request answers the first (repeated). Refuses a caller without PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE, which every step needs, HR-routed ones too (PERMISSION_DENIED), no request (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), another decision than the caller's first (ALREADY_DECIDED), a request no longer waiting (NOT_PENDING), a notice of an earlier revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a source changed since the request (SOURCE_CHANGED), a refusal without a reason (REASON_REQUIRED), the requester or the person it is about (SELF_APPROVAL) and anyone else not an approver of the step waiting (NOT_APPROVER). P22 review: a payroll configuration's step (PakPayrollConfig) is decided by its approvers holding PAYROLL_APPROVE or PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE, with PAYROLL_VIEW, never one who drafted it.

parameter.name: sourceEntityName
parameter.description: A kind's other source (P22 review: a pay structure of PakPayrollConfig, whose own is a pay component's term); its own when empty

service.description: What userId owns of People's approvals, for an offboarding preview: the requests waiting for their decision (resourceId approval:id, not transferable: a request follows its route and goes to the next approver once the rule or reporting line naming them changes) and the approval rule rows not ended (in effect or starting later) naming them as approver, alternate or HR fallback (resourceId policy:id, transferable), and the draft and open openings they are the recruiting owner of (resourceId opening:id, transferable; impl-people P16), and the open confidential cases they handle (resourceId case:id, named "Confidential case" alone, not transferable: when they leave, each goes back to the employer's case intake handlers; impl-people P21, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026), each {resourceId, resourceName, resourceKind, transferable, note}; names only. The caller's own, or another user's with PEOPLE_APPROVAL_OWNER_CHANGE.

An approval rule row naming fromUserId's person (as approver or alternate) handed to toUserId's: the row in effect ends now and its copy names the new person (a row not yet in effect changes in place), with the reason in the audit log; the waiting requests of its employer and kind are routed again. With PEOPLE_APPROVAL_OWNER_CHANGE, or by fromUserId holding PEOPLE_CONFIGURE in the rule's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise: an approver alone does not choose who decides in their place). Refuses a resource that is not such a row (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a waiting request or a confidential case (NOT_TRANSFERABLE), a new owner with no enabled account and person (OWNER_INVALID), one who does not work for the employer (NOT_EMPLOYED) and the rule's own employee (SELF_APPROVAL). An opening (opening:id, impl-people P16) gets the new recruiting owner, audit-logged with the reason: with PEOPLE_APPROVAL_OWNER_CHANGE or as a recruiter who changes the employer's openings; the new owner works for the employer (NOT_EMPLOYED) with an enabled account (OWNER_INVALID).
